description: Create, list, delete tags, tag/untag messages, get messages by tag, or get all tags for a specific message.

_account.description: Optional. Override identity for THIS call: pass the AgenticMail agent name (e.g. "Fola") to authenticate as that agent. Requires AGENTICMAIL_ACCOUNT_KEYS_JSON to contain a matching key. Omit to use the default identity (AGENTICMAIL_API_KEY).

color.description: Tag color hex code (for create, e.g. #ff0000)

folder.description: Folder the message is in (default: INBOX)

id.description: Tag ID (for delete, tag_message, untag_message, get_messages)

name: manage_tags
